cohort: The cohort consisted of 500 married women of reproductive age group residing for more than 6 months in the peri-urban and rural field practice areas of Aligarh, India, who consented to participate and did not have any chronic illness.
finding: The prevalence of RTI/STI symptoms was found to be 42.8% in rural areas, with these symptoms associated with lower educational status, early age of marriage, high parity, partner history of reproductive Tract Infections, and history of violence.
